scope: New place_run helper only. The harness/Store/API dispatch and control hook are integrated separately by root.

api.control: rebase_place_control(pending,before_state,new_version,*,now=None)->dict|None; invalid, expired or foreign authority returns None and must be cleared/reasked by caller.

implemented: Independent validated edits apply to a copy first. The resolution coordinator sees a virtual version old+1 only when canonical/control changes exist. One final Store.finish_run uses the original expected version and commits at most one revision.

Exact owned selection packets/country references may follow unrelated fact changes only when trip, old version and role/target physical scope remain valid. Candidate IDs are recomputed and only exact prior owned selection IDs are translated.
Selected snapshots are reverified against fresh/current exact catalog records; the snapshot physical source ID and country must match the exact shown candidate before applying its scoped setter.
The source coordinator cannot replace the human pending question with a model reply. Unexpected source/catalog failures use fixed safe errors/questions while preserving independently valid facts.
Before/after source calls and before final commit, the original run/session lease is fenced. A source layer swallowing the fence exception cannot cause a stale write.

Explicit wait defers validated request/selection and bounded remaining jobs without coordinator/catalog/search calls. A new wait with no data edits creates one control revision; an already paused session receives no redundant control revision.

Pure control rebase updates normal and deferred packet epochs, nested country references, derived candidate IDs and deferred selections together. Source timestamps/expiry are not refreshed and expired choices are never revived.

Maintenance mode with no new request/selection applies independent facts, rebinds the existing owned place question and asks it again without starting directory or supplier search. Deleted/changed targets are not retargeted to another stay.

Up to five remaining explicit jobs are persisted. After selection the next job is resolved before trip search. A freshly resolved country can feed an explicitly supplied same-role/same-target next city job without a redundant city-name question.

Server-only precomputed ask/no_match/unavailable packets avoid repeating an initial geographic lookup. They cannot inject setters or snapshots, accept independent edits, or bind a foreign trip/version.

open_boundaries: Root must gate dispatch behind the opt-in feature and wire Store control rebinding; these source integrations were not changed by this worker task.
The five PG tests do not qualify an actual supplier/LLM flow or full owner conversation.
Search is delegated to harness._search_trip after remaining jobs and missing facts are resolved. Root owns cumulative tool accounting across geographic and supplier phases.
Control rebinding returns None for stale/expired authority; caller must clear/reask rather than silently keeping old inner tokens.
No quote, confirmation, order, payment, hidden child run, local Qwen or unbounded source retry is created by the worker.
